lines: That was a good one.
I was there, and I still wanted to know how it ended.
Have you heard this one, though?
Make yourself comfortable. I've already done that.
Anyway. That's how that went.
I'd check the time, but I don't have a watch.
Or anywhere urgent to be.
Which reminds me of another time I should have gone home earlier.
I could do with a cup of tea after that.
You get one too, if you like. I'll wait.
Actually, I've thought of another story.
Bring the tea with you.
People keep telling me I should keep a diary.
I did try.
By Wednesday, it wouldn't shut properly.
Here. I'll tell you the next bit instead.
You'd think I'd have a sensible day after that.
Stay in. Do a little dusting.
I did intend to.
Then somebody spoke to me, which is usually where it starts.
There we are. Another perfectly ordinary thing I managed to be present for.
If you have questions, I probably had the same ones.
Mine went largely unanswered.
Now, this next one started quite innocently.
Shall we have a little stretch before the next one?
I've done mine.
You might have mistaken it for sitting slightly wider.
Right. Where were we? Oh, you'll like this.
That was the short version, by the way.
I left out a sandwich and quite a lot of waiting.
You're welcome.
I've got another one. I'll try to keep any sandwiches relevant.
You're still here!
Good. I was hoping you would be.
It's much nicer telling these to you than practising them in the bath.
The bath interrupts at all the wrong moments.
Anyway, listen to this.
Oh! I've just remembered one.
I'd put it somewhere safe in my head.
Must have been behind all the things I was supposed to do this week.
Never mind those. This is better.
